CELESTIAL MYSTERIES— By using the heavenly bodies, Paul revealed a unique revelation! (If you read the whole chapter, he sets forth a great drama) — | Cor. 15:40-41, There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial : but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another. There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars : for one star differeth from another star in glory. — As one star differs from another. (Like a snowflake, fingerprints and etc.) It showed the different positions of the elect, their glorious lights, work and leaderships. — Vrs. 51-52, Behold, | shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed, In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed. — “This glorified eternal body will be beyond imagination and incredible in every way angelic like unto His!” Also is beautiful in glowing light!

DANIEL THE PROPHET - gives us another view using the material to show the spiritual. Dan. 12:3-4, And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever. But thou, O Daniel shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end : many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased. — “And now as we see, the electronic knowledge and inventions we know the book is being opened before our eyes!”

CONTINUING— John’s Revelation — We see in his revelation something unique, spiritual and material! This means other things, but here is another valuable viewpoint. Rev. 12:1, And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars: - The Lord is clever! Awonder. A crown of 12 stars in like the 12 constellations! And the sun that clothed her and the moon under her feet goes through these constellations monthly and daily! For the prophetic revelations you will have to read the Scripts. We know this all reveals the Old Testament and New Testament saints, plus the elders, 12 Tribes and etc.

THE WISDOM AND KNOWLEDGE OF MAZZAROTH— Job 38;32-33, Can't though bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? Or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons? Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? Canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth? Mazzaroth is a mysterious circle of constellations in the heavens with heavenly bodies moving through as signs! (This circle is like a maze) — The Lord Himself said that certain things were determined! (Job 14:5) — This reveals futuristic prophecy already written in the Bible through periods of history! — It revealed His birth and it definitely is now revealing His Second Coming in unusual ways! (speaking of knowledge, man is now sending up by robot a new space telescope that will see 50 times further than ever before in the mighty gulfs of the Universe) They will be amazed and dumbfounded at the incredible sights!

THE HEAVENLY CLOCK— Jesus wisely revealed through His saints the heavens would be declaring what would be coming on the earth at His return when He spoke of Luke 21:25, And there shall be sings in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring; - We see what He was saying; He spoke of the heavens, then He declared what we would be seeing at our time. (you just read it) — Finally, people would be dismayed, in anxiety, perplexity and without resources not knowing which way to turn! As one cataclysm after another appeared! And we have definitely seen much already! “So He is near!”

CONTINUING PROPHECY -— Luke 21:11 (now here is a good interpretation of what Jesus said,) “There will be mighty and violent earthquakes and in various places famines and pestilence’s (plagues, malignant and contagious or infectious epidemic diseases, deadly and devastating). And there will be sights of horror and great signs from heaven.” | brought out a few more revelations. Also this takes in the satanic and angelic lights coming! It covers the coming of asteroids, fire balls, lightning and energy weapons and atomic power!

IN THE FUTURE: the presidency and whole way of government will change. As we predicted global society is eclipsing into a whole new world in the period ahead! “Jesus said, look up your redemption draweth nigh!” You would see many signs and prophecy from the heavens matching the Bible at His first coming: so shall it be at His Second Coming! Only the wise will understand! This earth has seen nothing yet in comparison to what lies in the near future! As the heavenly pendulum swings let us be ready and prepared to be caught up into a magnificent dimension!

PROPHETIC WARNING -— The apocalyptic age! The USA just printed a new coin with a horse and rider on it Remember Paul Revere was riding on a horse warning the British are coming? But now it’s warning of the 4 horses of the apolapse! It’s on a 25¢ piece (4 of a dollar) - And when the pale horse (Rev.6:8 — Death) rode, one fourth of mankind died! — In the later plagues more went. (Rev. chap.9 and chap.16) onslaught. — So like Paul Revere of the midnight ride, awake ye, awake ye! For they will definitely be asleep when the judgement falls! — Coin released in 1999 — turn it upside down 666. Shows later economics will change into a mark! Soon the dragon, the old serpent will glorify himself in the false church and government system! Note: Also the rider declares Ezek. Chap. 39 is coming! It shows Delaware the first state. And now we are in the last state of affairs and crisis — Note: The name Caesar appears on the coin (Pagan Rome collapsed into Papal Rome and now Babylon rising (Rev.chaps. 17 and 18) merging in connection with USA!

A UNIQUE PARABLE— Jesus revealed something in His day and through out the Church Ages, but at the end because of all the signs it may have a prophetic portent. — Quote St. John 4:35-36, Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? Behold, | say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest. And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together. — As we witness some of the final prophecies to the elect; also we see preparing of the Covenant, nature travailing as the sons of God come forth! So we may be right at the time (1999 cycle) wherein we might mention, say not there are yet 4 years (one month per year) until harvest, because harvest is already ending! So from this point (now) on the Lord may return and before the dates (4 years) is over, the world is in Great Tribulation! Note: This is a significant opinion only. Watch daily! “Jesus said, Behold, | come quickly!” — No matter, from now on the world is facing sudden and unexpected events! Note: Another way to look at it, using God’s ancient calendar 30 days per month before the flood; 4 months would be 120 days! The Lord told Noah it would be 120 years (Gen.6:3) and He would destroy mankind! We are not saying it would be 120 days. In symbolism before the next 4 years the world could be merged in the Great Tribulation and the Translation could take place anywhere from here on! (This is a significant opinion) — Here is another point, at the end of that time, the Lord told Noah, yet 7 days more (Gen.7:4) then began the flood. If we add one day per year, then Armageddon could be starting or over! | might say this let the wise understand and watch and pray! “Jesus said, As in the days of Noah, so shall it be again!” — All of this above is within seasonal reason!

The Lord did not hide from (elect) Abraham the fiery overthrow of Sodom and the cities of the plains. (Gen.19:27-29) — “So indeed in our day He will not show us the day nor the hour, but His people may well know within a year or a month.” (A season) — Read paragraph below.

CYCLES OF PROPHECY - “The Lord, time angel of the old Testament foretold exact events beforehand. The flood forecast 120 years in advance!” (Gen. 6:3) — “The Egyptian judgment predicted 400 years ahead!” (Gen 15:13-14) — ‘The entrance into Canaan 40 years before!” (Nums. 14:33-34) — “The return to Babylon foreknown 70 years!” (Dan 9:2) — “The death of Messiah foretold 483 years before!” (Dan. 9:25-26) — “Jesus prophesied of His own resurrection to occur in 3 days!” (Matt. 12:40) — “Jesus foretold at the budding of the Fig Tree (Israel in their homeland) that He would return in the same generation although He did not give the exact date! — The end of the millennium foreseen as one thousand years!” (Rev. 20:7) — “The Lord actually set dates for the other events above so we may realize He also will reveal the times of the end of the age! The most important events ever!
